speaker: Amy Laurent
quote: We know even from diagnostics, right, from the DSM V, that social communication and social interactive difficulties are part and parcel of the diagnosis of individuals with autism on the spectrum.

speaker: Amy Laurent
quote: But we also need to understand the breadth of social communicative competence and not just focus solely on the social communication piece of it.

speaker: Amy Laurent
